scenes.name: WHO READS THE TABLE
lines: A pointer reads memory through a page table. But the table lives in memory too.
指针要查页表才能读到内存；可页表本身也住在内存里。
Who translates the table's own address? A bigger table needs another, and another, without end.
页表自己的地址由谁来翻译？请来更大的一张表，它又要再上一张，没有尽头。

scenes.name: SLOT ZERO
lines: Instead, write the directory's own address into its slot zero.
换个办法：把页目录自己的地址写进它的零号槽。
Index one, two takes two hops: through the directory, through a leaf table, to a data frame.
索引 [1, 2] 走两跳：穿过页目录、穿过叶页表，落到数据帧。
Index zero, one loops back once, so the second hop hands back the leaf table itself, as data.
索引 [0, 1] 先原地绕回一次，第二跳交出来的就是叶页表本身，当作数据。
Index zero, zero: every hop comes home. The address and what it holds are one number. p equals star p.
索引 [0, 0]：每一跳都回到原处。地址与它存着的内容是同一个数：p = *p。

scenes.name: DIAGONAL
lines: Why does this work? Take any table g and a map f. Read the diagonal and apply f: that is a new row.
为什么行得通？任取一张表 g 和一个映射 f：沿对角线读下来再作用 f，得到新的一行。
If f moves every value, as flipping a bit does, the new row differs from row a at entry a. It escapes every table.
若 f 处处挪动取值（比如翻转一个比特），新行在第 a 格就与第 a 行不同：它逃出每一张表。
If instead some row a-nought is the diagonal, then the cell a-nought, a-nought is a fixed point of f.
反过来，若某一行 a₀ 正是这条对角线，那么格子 (a₀, a₀) 就是 f 的不动点。
Lean has checked both statements, for any types, finite or not.
这两条都已由 Lean 内核检验，对任意类型成立，有限无限都一样。

scenes.name: HALF TURN
lines: One loop closes the table. Now turn a spinor through a full circle in a plane.
一圈回环就合上了页表。现在让一个旋量在一个平面里转满一整圈。
The current J, made from psi and its reverse, comes all the way back. Psi itself has turned only half way: its sign is minus one.
由 ψ 与其反序夹出的流向量 J 完整地转了回来；ψ 自己却只转了一半，符号成了 −1。
On the circle, squaring is a double cover. Lift one full turn from one, and the only continuous lift ends at minus one.
在圆周上，平方映射是双覆叠。从 1 出发提升绕一整圈，唯一的连续提升停在 −1。
A second turn, seven hundred and twenty degrees in all, brings it home to plus one.
再转一圈，合计 720°，它才回到 +1。

scenes.name: NO SECTION
lines: Could we choose one square root for every point, continuously, and dodge the flip?
能不能给每一点连续地选定一个平方根，躲开这次翻转？
Plant a root every thirty degrees, each next to the last. Back at the start, the last one points the other way.
每隔 30° 插一面小旗，每一面都挨着上一面；回到起点时，最后一面与第一面方向相反。
Lean has checked it: the squaring cover of the circle has no continuous global section.
这一条已由 Lean 内核检验：圆周的平方覆叠没有连续的全局截面。
